objective: Prove the all-prime sparse recovery threshold and classify every disjoint tie at its first possible size, with a counterexample test for common states.
status: Proved: Over a prime alphabet of size p every table of fewer than p states is recoverable. Disjoint minimum ties are the two complete families at distinct differences. Minimum ties replacing one state are in bijection with derangements of p−1 positions for each crossing pair.
title: Determine the sparse recovery threshold after all crossing powers
